hotel.name: The St. Regis Kanai Resort, Riviera Maya

verified_facts.text: The resort is in Kanai, Mexico, near Cancun and Playa del Carmen.
verified_facts.excerpt: in Kanai, a resort in Mexico near Cancun and Playa del Carmen

verified_facts.text: The resort is built on a natural mangrove reserve.
verified_facts.excerpt: Built on a natural mangrove reserve and inspired by the Sian Ka’an Reserve, a UNESCO World Heritage Site

verified_facts.text: The resort's architecture was inspired by the Pleiades constellation and floats above the mangrove canopy.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Pleiades constellation inspired our avant-garde architecture, floating above the mangrove canopy.

verified_facts.text: The architecture is by Edmonds International.
verified_facts.excerpt: innovative architecture by Edmonds International—inspired by the constellation Pleiades

verified_facts.text: The interior design is by Toronto-based Chapi Chapo design.
verified_facts.excerpt: The overall interior design, by Toronto-based Chapi Chapo design

verified_facts.text: Guests reach restaurants and beach clubs on wooden walkways, with golf cart transport as an option.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests access restaurants, beach clubs and the like via wooden walkways, with the option to be transported via golf cart.

verified_facts.text: The resort was built as a suspended structure with elevated walkways so it does not disturb the root systems of the 400-year-old mangrove.
verified_facts.excerpt: preserve the 400 year-old mangrove, resulting in a suspended structure with an interconnected network of elevated walkways that does not disturb the delicate root systems

verified_facts.text: Every room features a private terrace or plunge pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: features dramatic views, bespoke furniture, and a private terrace or plunge pool

verified_facts.text: Guests in all room categories have access to St. Regis Butler Service.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests of all room categories will also have access to the St. Regis Signature Butler Service

verified_facts.text: Room headboards are walnut wood walls carved in a pattern based on Mayan textiles.
verified_facts.excerpt: The headboard is a large walnut wood wall carved in a pattern based on Mayan textiles

verified_facts.text: Toro serves dishes reflecting Mexico and Latin America under the direction of Chef Richard Sandoval.
verified_facts.excerpt: This bespoke beachfront dining venue in Riviera Maya serves dishes reflecting the spirit of Mexico and Latin America under the direction of Chef Richard Sandoval.

verified_facts.text: The St. Regis Bar is on the top floor of the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Mingle at The St. Regis Bar, located on the top floor of our resort in Quintana Roo.

verified_facts.text: The St. Regis Bar serves drinks inspired by the constellations.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sip beverages inspired by the constellations, creatively crafted to surprise the senses.

verified_facts.text: The St. Regis Bar features an expansive mural inspired by Maya astronomer-priests.
verified_facts.excerpt: It also features an expansive mural inspired by Maya astronomer-priests who looked to the heavens for guidance.

verified_facts.text: The resort's version of the Bloody Mary, the Kanai Mary, is made with local spices and ingredients.
verified_facts.excerpt: savor our iconic Kanai Mary made with exquisite local spices and ingredients

verified_facts.text: The Library hosts afternoon tea and Mexican chocolate tastings.
verified_facts.excerpt: The perfect back drop to experience St. Regis’s signature ritual of afternoon tea and enjoy a tasting of Mexican chocolate.

verified_facts.text: Riviera is a seafood restaurant drawing on the flavors of Mexico's Pacific and Caribbean coasts.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our seafood restaurant in Riviera Maya captures the flavors of Mexico's Pacific and Caribbean coasts

verified_facts.text: The St. Regis Spa offers Mayan-infused services inspired by Mayan cosmology.
verified_facts.excerpt: Taking inspiration from Mayan cosmology, St Regis Spa incorporates a collection of Mayan-infused services into its exclusive menu.

verified_facts.text: The spa's hydrotherapy area has a sauna, steam room, whirlpool, cold plunge and relaxation pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: the hydrotherapy area that has a sauna, steam room, whirlpool, cold plunge and relaxation pool

verified_facts.text: The spa has separate men's and women's outdoor thermal circuits and pools.
verified_facts.excerpt: separate men's/women's outdoor thermal circuits and pools

verified_facts.text: Beach cabanas have ocean views and a private swim-out pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ocean view cabana with private swim-out pool, enhanced amenities, exclusive F&B selection and personalized service.

verified_facts.text: The fitness center has Italian-designed Technogym equipment.
verified_facts.excerpt: Full line of refined Italian-designed Technogym equipment available for our Luminaries.

verified_facts.text: LUX Tennis Club is in Kanai's private community.
verified_facts.excerpt: Elevate your tennis game in Riviera Maya at LUX Tennis Club, nestled in Kanai’s private community.

verified_facts.text: The Tortuga Children's Club has its own pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: There’s also a Tortuga Children’s Club with its own pool, and babysitting can be arranged as needed.

verified_facts.text: The family pool area has its own restaurant and cabanas.
verified_facts.excerpt: The family pool area here is quite substantial, with its own restaurant and cabanas.

verified_facts.text: Sabrage is the signature ceremony of the St. Regis evening rituals at the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: the art of Sabrage is the signature ceremony of the St. Regis Evening Rituals series.

verified_facts.text: The name Kanai means 'the House of the Sky'.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Mayans, who gave the land its name, meaning “the House of the Sky”

verified_facts.text: The resort's sustainability initiative is led by an expert biologist.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our dedication to sustainability is reflected through an initiative, led by an expert biologist

verified_facts.text: The resort produces its own water by reverse osmosis and bottles it in reusable glass.
verified_facts.excerpt: It also produces its own water via reverse osmosis, and packages it in reusable glass bottles.

verified_facts.text: The resort is Green Key certified.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Green Key Certified

verified_facts.text: Cancun International Airport is about 28.7 miles from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: CUN is located approximately 28.7 Miles from the hotel.

verified_facts.text: The hotel does not provide shuttle service.
verified_facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

verified_facts.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.
verified_facts.excerpt: Minimum Age to Check In: 18

verified_facts.text: June is typically exceedingly hot and humid at the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: It was also, to be fair, exceedingly hot and humid, which is typical for this time of year (June).
